name: T-Shirt Kingdom
storyline:
Welcome to the T-Shirt Kingdom, a realm once overflowing with art, where everyone from the royal court to the common subjects shared a deep passion for creation

A supernatural catastrophe swept through the land, washing away all T-shirt art and stripping the world of its pigments.

Worse still was the toll it took on the kingdom's spirit—art withered within the hearts of the people. The epicenter of this disaster became known as the "Singularity."

The Singularity's blight lingers still. Fortunately, under the King's guidance, the realm has finally welcomed the painter they have so desperately awaited

With the support and expectations of the King and his subjects, you will engage in boundless creation to bring the vitality of art back to the T-Shirt Kingdom.
summary: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.
